{{- /* Internal links in the prose are written as `/docs/
/`, which is exactly right when the site is mounted at /docs/ (inside the binary) and exactly wrong anywhere else: on GitHub Pages the site sits at /mailyard/ and a root-relative /docs/... link leaves it. So a link starting with /docs/ is re-rooted through relURL, which prepends whatever path the configured baseURL carries - /docs/x stays /docs/x, and under Pages it becomes /mailyard/x. Every other destination (absolute URLs, anchors, mailto) is written as it came. */ -}} {{- $href := .Destination -}} {{- if eq $href "/docs/" -}} {{- $href = site.Home.RelPermalink -}} {{- else if hasPrefix $href "/docs/" -}} {{- $href = strings.TrimPrefix "/docs/" $href | relURL -}} {{- end -}} {{ .Text }}
